description: Executable parcel providers with cityIds for shared-provider city entries; research-only sources remain in registry.json until verified.

sources.name: City of Toronto Property Boundary
sources.scope: City of Toronto municipal parcel fabric; surrounding municipalities are separate sources
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Toronto.

sources.name: Quebec cadastre renovated-lot polygons (GO01_Polygones_Lots)
sources.scope: Quebec-wide generalized renewed-cadastre lot polygons; Montreal is an indicative entry area only, not a Montreal-specific layer. Geometry is indicative and has no legal value; some polygons may represent complementary plans.
sources.licenceNote: Reuse terms are informational; integration is enabled based on verified public endpoint behavior. Preserve attribution and the indicative-only caveat.
sources.attribution: Gouvernement du Québec · cadastre_bd_allegee / GO01_Polygones_Lots. Indicative cadastral geometry; coordinates have no legal value. Adapted to WGS84.

sources.name: Bogotá IDECA/UAECD lots — CAR mirror, December 2021
sources.publisher: Corporación Autónoma Regional de Cundinamarca (CAR), using IDECA/UAECD data
sources.scope: December 2021 copy of Bogotá Distrito Capital urban and rural lots, explicitly selected for the prototype. A lot may contain multiple properties; neighbouring municipalities are separate sources.
sources.attribution: IDECA/UAECD Lote — December 2021, served by CAR, CC BY 4.0. Adapted to canonical WGS84 parcel features.

sources.name: Los Angeles County Assessor parcels
sources.scope: Los Angeles County only; county assessor polygons do not establish coverage of adjacent counties or separate condominium title boundaries.
sources.attribution: County of Los Angeles, Assessor parcels. Enterprise GIS Repository. Accessed October 2, 2026. Adapted to WGS84.

sources.name: Miami-Dade County Property Appraiser parcels
sources.scope: Miami-Dade County only; does not cover Broward or Palm Beach counties. Property assessment polygons are approximate.
sources.attribution: Miami-Dade County GIS, Property Appraiser parcels. Adapted to WGS84.
sources.licenceNote: Official public dataset supplies data for use subject to an accuracy/reliance disclaimer; no named open-data licence is stated.

sources.name: District of Columbia DCGIS tax lots
sources.scope: District of Columbia assessment tax lots, not legal survey/record lots. SSL numbers are not unique; each GlobalID identifies a separate polygon. Adjacent Virginia and Maryland jurisdictions need separate sources.
sources.attribution: District of Columbia, DCGIS Tax Lots, CC BY 4.0. Adapted to WGS84.

sources.name: France IGN/DGFiP Parcellaire Express (PCI)
sources.scope: IGN assembly of vectorised DGFiP cadastral parcels across France; bounded Paris and Lyon globe entries are enabled and verified. Non-vectorised areas and cadastral alignment gaps remain possible.
sources.attribution: IGN/DGFiP, Parcellaire Express (PCI), catalogue and updates linked; accessed October 2, 2026. Licence Ouverte 2.0. Adapted to WGS84.

sources.name: Victoria Vicmap Parcel (PARCEL_MP)
sources.scope: Victoria cadastral parcel map polygons; distinct from local-government property assessment units. Other Australian states use separate datasets. Only Approved (A) parcel and version records are ground; Proposed (P) records are excluded. Crown and government-road parcels remain included. Only G (unrestricted ground) and S (ground surface affected by strata) levels are ground; above/below strata are excluded.
sources.attribution: State of Victoria, Department of Transport and Planning, Vicmap Parcel. CC BY 4.0. Adapted to WGS84.

sources.name: City of Cape Town Land Parcels
sources.scope: City of Cape Town municipal cadastral parcels; duplicate address rows with the same SG26 code and identical geometry collapse to one parcel. Conflicting geometry fails closed. Other South African municipalities use separate sources.
sources.attribution: City of Cape Town, Land Parcels. Adapted to WGS84.
sources.licenceNote: Official public open-data item; named reuse licence not established. Linked City open-data terms page returned 404 at verification.

sources.name: Netherlands Kadaster / PDOK cadastral map
sources.scope: National Dutch cadastral map; bounded Amsterdam and Rotterdam globe entries are enabled. Valid (G) records only. Boundaries are indicative and unsuitable for survey measurements or establishing legal title.
sources.attribution: Kadaster / PDOK, Kadastrale Kaart, CC BY 4.0. Adapted to WGS84.

sources.name: Flanders Digitaal Vlaanderen GRB administrative parcels
sources.scope: Flanders GRB administrative cadastral-map objects; permanent OIDN identity, UIDN version metadata and CAPAKEY cadastral association. Graphic depiction corrected to terrain, not a legal survey boundary. Only bounded Antwerp globe entry is enabled; Brussels and Wallonia need separate sources.
sources.attribution: Bron: Grootschalig Referentie Bestand Vlaanderen, Digitaal Vlaanderen. Adapted to WGS84.

sources.name: Geobasis NRW ALKIS parcels
sources.scope: North Rhine-Westphalia ALKIS cadastral map; bounded Essen, Cologne and Dortmund globe entries enabled. Other German states need separate sources. The named flstkennz identity is serialized as GeoJSON feature.id; objid and aktualit remain version metadata.
sources.attribution: Bezirksregierung Köln / Geobasis NRW, ALKIS simplified schema. Datenlizenz Deutschland – Zero 2.0. Adapted to WGS84.

sources.name: San Francisco current recorded-map ground parcels
sources.scope: City and County of San Francisco current recorded-map ground footprints only. Active Public Works map rows are grouped by the documented mapblklot ground key after identical-geometry checks; blklot identifies assessment rows, not separate condominium ground. Retired and assessment-only records excluded. Adjacent counties need separate sources.
sources.attribution: City and County of San Francisco / DataSF, Parcels – Active and Retired. PDDL 1.0. Adapted to WGS84 ground footprints.

sources.name: Berlin ALKIS cadastral parcels
sources.scope: Land Berlin ALKIS cadastral parcels; Brandenburg and the wider metropolitan area need separate sources. The native fsko cadastral key identifies ground, uuid is the separate object ID and beg records object version start.
sources.attribution: Land Berlin / Geoportal Berlin, ALKIS Flurstücke. Datenlizenz Deutschland – Zero 2.0. Adapted to WGS84.

sources.name: Hong Kong Lands Department private-lot index
sources.scope: Lands Department iC1000 private-lot index only. Government Land Allocations and Short-Term Tenancies are separate collections and are not enabled here. Native lotid is distinct from transport WFS FID and the displayed lot name. Only bounded Hong Kong entry enabled; boundaries are indicative, not legal survey proof.
sources.attribution: Map from Lands Department. © Government of the Hong Kong SAR / CSDI. Adapted to WGS84. Official Lands Department logo displayed on map face.

sources.name: SPRDF / NINACAD cadastral parcels
sources.scope: Bamako test neighbourhood and other NINACAD-mapped parcels only; sampled coverage is partial. The central city box was previously empty. No ownership or title certification supplied.
sources.licenceNote: No explicit geometry reuse licence established; source conditions remain informational under the user-selected passthrough policy.
sources.attribution: SPRDF / NINACAD cadastral parcels; adapted to WGS84. See publisher conditions.

sources.name: SEDAPAL Lima lots
sources.scope: Utility mapping/lot layer; legal-cadastre status and citywide coverage are not established by this sample. Only the bounded Lima globe entry is enabled.
sources.licenceNote: No explicit reuse licence is published in the checked service metadata; source conditions remain informational.
sources.attribution: SEDAPAL — Proyectos_Sedapal / Lotes. The third-party copy describes a SEDAPAL-commissioned Consorcio Servicios Integrales vector file; preserve that attribution when appropriate.

sources.name: GGPEN Luanda property polygons
sources.scope: Property polygons in a Maianga sample; not verified as the authoritative legal parcel register. Only the bounded Luanda globe entry is enabled.
sources.licenceNote: No explicit reuse licence is published in the checked service metadata; source conditions remain informational.
sources.attribution: GGPEN / Luanda_AGT_Oficial_2_gdb layer 0. Preserve the publisher and layer name in source metadata.

sources.name: NSW Spatial Services cadastral lots
sources.scope: New South Wales cadastral lots; a bounded western Sydney metropolitan entry is enabled around the verified sample. This does not establish complete Sydney coverage or legal title.
sources.licenceNote: NSW Spatial Services publishes attribution conditions and restrictions on automated retrieval; users are responsible for checking the publisher conditions for their intended use.
sources.attribution: NSW Spatial Services / Department of Customer Service, cadastral lots; adapted to WGS84. See publisher conditions.

sources.name: GeoSampa São Paulo fiscal lots
sources.scope: São Paulo municipal fiscal cadastral lots. Fiscal identifiers and lot geometry do not establish legal title; only the bounded São Paulo globe entry is enabled.
sources.licenceNote: GeoSampa/PMSP publisher conditions apply; users are responsible for checking source terms for their intended use. Live viewer data is updated daily and downloadable files weekly, according to the publisher.
sources.attribution: GeoSampa / Prefeitura do Município de São Paulo, municipal fiscal lots; adapted to WGS84.

sources.name: Birmingham HMLR title-index polygons — Geodom mirror, October 2021
sources.scope: Partial Midlands extract near Birmingham from a third-party October 22, 2021 mirror of HMLR INSPIRE title-index polygons. Non-title placeholder rows are excluded; missing native IDs cannot become canonical parcels. Empty cells mean no registered-title index polygons in this extract, not absence of physical parcels or ownership.
sources.licenceNote: Geodom is an unofficial mirror publisher; host-specific conditions are not documented in the checked metadata. Underlying HMLR title-index and mirror publisher conditions remain informational.
sources.attribution: HM Land Registry INSPIRE title-index polygons, dated 2021-10-22; public Geodom mirror. Adapted to WGS84.

sources.name: Lusaka Mtendere East parcels (ArcGIS Online)
sources.scope: Unofficial ArcGIS Online layer named Parcels_Mtendere_East; only 28 polygons in one Lusaka settlement. Not a citywide or official legal-cadastre source.
sources.licenceNote: Publisher authority and reuse terms are unconfirmed; retain the scope and attribution notice. Source terms are informational for this prototype.
sources.attribution: Parcels_Mtendere_East — Lusaka_parcels_creation (ArcGIS Online account eodoi_medeem; publisher authority unconfirmed). Adapted; limited to 28 polygons in Mtendere East.

sources.name: MOJ public-coordinate map sheets — Osaka, Tokyo and Nagoya, 2026
sources.scope: Partial 2026 converted MOJ public-coordinate registry-map packages: Osaka Chuo ward (2487 polygons), Tokyo Chiyoda ward (236) and Nagoya Chikusa ward (284). Only these three verified packages are enabled; sheets without public coordinates are omitted. No citywide or Japan-wide completeness is claimed. Pinned snapshots use five-minute transient-memory caching, without parcel writes to disk or a database.
sources.licenceNote: Geospatial Information Center catalogue lists CC BY; underlying Ministry of Justice data and conversion-publisher conditions also apply. Publisher warns that public-coordinate sheets only are converted and some geometries may be misplaced. Conditions are informational.
sources.attribution: Japan Ministry of Justice registry-map data; Geospatial Information Center / AIGID conversion, 2026. Osaka Chuo ward public-coordinate sheets only; adapted to WGS84.

sources.name: ANDF e-Foncier cadastral parcels — Cotonou
sources.scope: Verified bounded Cotonou cadastral parcel samples from the ANDF e-Foncier service. Only the configured Cotonou entry is enabled; coverage beyond the tested cells and national completeness are unverified.
sources.licenceNote: ANDF describes public consultation and duplication except personal or confidential information, with online/private access subject to conditions and fees. GeoServer Fees NONE / AccessConstraints NONE are service defaults, not a reuse licence. Publisher conditions remain informational.
sources.attribution: ANDF (Agence Nationale du Domaine et du Foncier), e-Foncier cadastral parcels; adapted to WGS84. Verified Cotonou samples only.

sources.name: DGU live cadastral parcels
sources.scope: Croatian national DKP cadastral geometry; public WFS token configured on the proxy. Ownership is not streamed.
sources.licenceNote: Source terms are informational; users choose their source and intended use.

sources.scope: Official Shenzhen public cadastral-map service, publisher excludes Shenshan Cooperation Zone. Only a bounded central entry and nearby pan have been verified; not a claim of complete city or China coverage.
sources.licenceNote: Public source notices and reuse conditions are informational; users choose the source and intended use.
sources.attribution: Shenzhen Municipal Planning and Natural Resources Bureau · public cadastral-map query service. Adapted to WGS84.

sources.name: NYC Department of Finance Digital Tax Map

sources.licenceNote: Source terms are informational; users choose their source and intended use.

sources.licenceNote: Source terms are informational; users choose their source and intended use.

sources.scope: Official GURS cadastral parcel service; acceptance evidence covers bounded Ljubljana cells only, not national completeness.
sources.attribution: Geodetska uprava Republike Slovenije (GURS), cadastral parcels. Adapted to WGS84.
